u0: At the start, the agent has not picked up the matching key, the door is closed, and the target box has not been collected. The task is to take the key, use it to open the door, and then pick up the target box. Opening the door without having held the key, or collecting the box before the door has been opened, irreversibly fails the task.
u1: A mandatory ordering requirement has been broken: either the door was opened before the matching key had been taken, or the target box was picked up before the door had been opened. This failure is irreversible, so successful completion is no longer possible.
u2: The matching key has been picked up while the door is still closed, and the target box has not been collected. The remaining task is to open the door and then pick up the target box; picking up the box before the door is opened would fail the task. If the key is dropped before the door is opened, it must be recovered so the door can still be opened later.
u3: The door has been opened successfully and the target box has not yet been picked up. The remaining objective is to collect the target box; the door may currently be open or closed, and the key may or may not still be carried. If the door was closed again while the key was still held, it must be reopened before the task can finish; otherwise, picking up the target box completes the task.
u4: The target box has been picked up and all mandatory requirements have been satisfied: the matching key had been obtained by the time the door was opened, the door had been opened by the time the box was collected, and any later requirement to reopen the door after holding the key has been met. No objectives remain and the task is complete.
u5: The door was open earlier but has been closed again while the target box remains uncollected, and an outstanding requirement to open it again is pending because the key was held while the door was closed. Reopening the door restores the earlier progress and then the target box can be collected. If the box is picked up before the door is reopened, the door must still be opened afterward to finish.
u6: The target box has been picked up, but the door is currently closed and an outstanding key-related obligation still requires it to be opened. Opening the door is the final remaining step; completion is not achieved until that happens.
